#ifdef __TINYC__
/* TinyCC's Windows import set has no MSVC byte-swap intrinsics. */
static inline uint32_t tiny_nghttp2_bswap32(uint32_t n) {
  return (n >> 24) | ((n >> 8) & 0x0000ff00u) |
         ((n << 8) & 0x00ff0000u) | (n << 24);
}
static inline uint16_t tiny_nghttp2_bswap16(uint16_t n) {
  return (uint16_t)((n >> 8) | (n << 8));
}
#define _byteswap_ulong tiny_nghttp2_bswap32
#define _byteswap_ushort tiny_nghttp2_bswap16
#endif
